40672-the-white-virgin.title: The White Virgin
40672-the-white-virgin.creator: George Manville Fenn
40672-the-white-virgin.description: A book by George Manville Fenn. "Don't be a young fool," cried the Doctor testily. "I can describe Janet better than you can. Now, look here, boy; I've got two things to say to you. First of all, about this `White Virgin'."

61219-central-station-electric-lighting-.title: Distribution Of Electricity.
61219-central-station-electric-lighting-.creator: Killingworth Hedges,
61219-central-station-electric-lighting-.description: A book by Killingworth Hedges,. The distribution of electricity from a central-station, which was the subject of Sir William Siemen’s Presidential Address at the Society of Arts in 1882, is not only accomplished from the scientific point of view, but is also a commercial success: the power of flowing water, or the potential energy stored up in coal, wood, or other fuel, can be utilised for lighting our streets and houses at night, and during the day may be transmitted by means of electricity in the easiest possible way, and

arxiv-1910-09438.title: Entry Trajectory Optimization for Mars Science Laboratory Class Missions Using Indirect Unified Trigonometrization Method*
arxiv-1910-09438.creator: Kshitij Mall, Ehsan Taheri
arxiv-1910-09438.description: Abstract Application of traditional indirect optimization methods to optimal control problems (OCPs) with control and state path constraints is not a straightforward task. However, recent advances in regularization techniques and numerical continuation methods have enabled application of indirect methods to very complex OCPs.

arxiv-2106-09728.title: Timothy Cohen
arxiv-2106-09728.description: Abstract Stochastic Inflation at NNLO 1 Institute for Fundamental Science, University of Oregon, Eugene, OR 97403, USA 2 Department of Physics, University of California at San Diego, La Jolla, CA 92093, USA Abstract Stochastic Inflation is an important framework for understanding the physics of de Sitter space and the phenomenology of inflation.

arxiv-2110-10796.title: distribution and moments of the error term in the lattice point counting problem for 3 3 -dimensional Cygan-Korányi balls
arxiv-2110-10796.creator: YOAV A. GATH
arxiv-2110-10796.description: Abstract . We study fluctuations of the error term for the number of integer lattice points lying inside a 3 3 -dimensional Cygan-Korányi ball of large radius. We prove that the error term, suitably normalized, has a limiting value distribution which is absolutely continuous, and we provide estimates for the decay rate of the corresponding density on the real line.

arxiv-2308-02970.title: Resource Management for GPT-based Model Deployed on Clouds: Challenges, Solutions, and Future Directions
arxiv-2308-02970.creator: Yongkang Dang, Minxian Xu, Kejiang Ye
arxiv-2308-02970.description: Abstract The widespread adoption of the large language model (LLM), e.g. Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT), deployed on cloud computing environment (e.g. Azure) has led to a huge increased demand for resources. This surge in demand poses significant challenges to resource management in clouds.

arxiv-2311-06684.title: Contraction-based Tracking Control of Electromechanical Systems
arxiv-2311-06684.creator: Najmeh Javanmardi, Pablo Borja, Jacquelien M. A. Scherpen ✉
arxiv-2311-06684.description: Abstract This paper addresses the trajectory-tracking problem for a class of electromechanical systems. To this end, the dynamics of the plants are modeled in the so-called port-Hamiltonian framework. Then, the notion of contraction is exploited to design the desired closed-loop dynamics and the corresponding tracking controller.

arxiv-2405-15176.title: MonoDETRNext: Next-Generation Accurate and Efficient Monocular 3D Object Detector
arxiv-2405-15176.creator: Liao Pan, Yang Feng*, Wu Di, Zhao Wenhui, Yu Jinwen
arxiv-2405-15176.description: Abstract Monocular 3D object detection has vast application potential across various fields. DETR-type models have shown remarkable performance in different areas, but there is still considerable room for improvement in monocular 3D detection, especially with the existing DETR-based method, MonoDETR.

arxiv-2504-09894.title: A mechanical approach to facilitate the formation of dodecagonal quasicrystals and their approximants
arxiv-2504-09894.creator: Zhehua Jiang, Jianhua Zhang, Mengyuan Zhan, Jiaqi Si, Junchao Huang, Hua Tong, Ning Xu
arxiv-2504-09894.description: Abstract The conditions for forming quasicrystals and their approximants are stringent, normally requiring multiple length scales to stabilize the quasicrystalline order. Here we report an unexpected finding that the approximants and motifs of dodecagonal quasicrystals can be spontaneously formed in the simplest system of identical hard disks, utilizing the unstable feature of the initial square packing subject to mechanical perturbations.

arxiv-2505-15025.title: Inverse Optimization via Learning Feasible Regions
arxiv-2505-15025.creator: Ke Ren, Peyman Mohajerin Esfahani, Angelos Georghiou
arxiv-2505-15025.description: Abstract We study inverse optimization (IO) where the goal is to use a parametric optimization program as the hypothesis class to infer relationships between input-decision pairs. Most of the literature focuses on learning only the objective function, as learning the constraint function (i.e., feasible regions) leads to nonconvex training programs.

arxiv-2506-10586.title: Size-adaptive Hypothesis Testing for Fairness
arxiv-2506-10586.creator: Antonio Ferrara, Francesco Cozzi, Alan Perotti, André Panisson, Francesco Bonchi
arxiv-2506-10586.description: Abstract Determining whether an algorithmic decision-making system discriminates against a specific demographic typically involves comparing a single point estimate of a fairness metric against a predefined threshold. This practice is statistically brittle: it ignores sampling error and treats small demographic subgroups the same as large ones.

arxiv-2509-26052.title: Abelian 3D TQFT gravity, ensemble holography and stabilizer states
arxiv-2509-26052.creator: Nikolaos Angelinos
arxiv-2509-26052.description: Abstract We construct a model of 3D quantum gravity based on abelian topological quantum field theory (TQFT), by defining the gravitational path-integral as a sum over all 3D topologies with genus- g g boundary Σ g \Sigma_{g} . The path-integral of an abelian TQFT 𝒯 \mathcal{T} on any single topology with boundary Σ g \Sigma_{g} prepares a stabilizer state.

pmc-10548330.title: An mHealth Platform for People With HIV Receiving Care in Washington, District of Columbia: Qualitative Analysis of Stakeholder Feedback
pmc-10548330.creator: Sylvia Caldwell, Tabor Flickinger, Jacqueline Hodges, Ava Lena D Waldman, Chloe Garofalini, Wendy Cohn, Rebecca Dillingham, Amanda Castel, Karen Ingersoll, Amaryllis Mavragani, Tess Filipowicz
pmc-10548330.description: BackgroundHIV viral suppression and retention in care continue to be challenging goals for people with HIV in Washington, District of Columbia (DC). The PositiveLinks mobile app is associated with increased retention in care and viral load suppression in nonurban settings.

pmc-11385631.title: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis: clinical characteristics and updates in diagnosis
pmc-11385631.creator: Malgorzata Potentas-Policewicz, Justyna Fijolek
pmc-11385631.description: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis (GPA) is a rare systemic disease characterized by granulomatous inflammation of the respiratory tract and necrotizing vasculitis of small and medium vessels often associated with the production of anti-neutrophil cytoplasmic antibodies (ANCA) directed mainly against leukocyte proteinase 3 (PR3). Usually, it involves upper airways, lungs, and kidneys, however any organ may be affected.

pmc-11727095.title: Urinary Immune Complexes Reflect Renal Pathology in Lupus Nephritis
pmc-11727095.creator: Chenling Tang, Aygun Teymur, Tianfu Wu
pmc-11727095.description: Background/Objectives: Lupus nephritis (LN) is a serious complication of systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), involving immune complex deposition in the kidneys. While renal biopsy is the diagnostic gold standard, its invasiveness limits frequent use, driving the need for non-invasive urinary biomarkers to monitor disease progression and response to treatment. This study aimed to identify and validate urinary biomarkers for LN.

pmc-12681554.title: Mapping the intracellular HMGB1 interactome and alterations induced by Toll-like receptor 4 activation
pmc-12681554.creator: Rebecka Heinbäck, Marit van der Zijde, Choi Har Tsang, Tilen Tršelič, Alexander Espinosa, Cecilia Aulin, Helena Erlandsson Harris
pmc-12681554.description: The evolutionary conserved, mammalian protein HMGB1 is involved in chromatin-related mechanisms, autophagy, and sensing of immunogenic DNA. HMGB1 translocates from the nucleus to the cytosol in stressed myeloid cells, implicating functional changes. However, the role of intracellular HMGB1 in homeostatic conditions and alterations caused by stress remains largely unexplored.

pmc-12721726.title: Extensive Orthodontic Movement in an Adolescent Patient With a Traumatized and Endodontically Treated Maxillary Central Incisor: Case Report With 7 Years of Follow‐Up
pmc-12721726.creator: Elisa Souza Camargo, Layza Rossatto Oppitz, Ana Carolina Mastriani Arantes, Caio Seiti Miyoshi, Carlos Roberto Novakowski Filho, Oscar Mario Antelo Ribera, Patricia Kern Di Scala Andreis
pmc-12721726.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This article describes the orthodontic treatment involving a traumatized, endodontically treated upper central incisor that underwent extensive orthodontic movement. A male patient, 13 years and 1 month old, presented with the following conditions: mesofacial, convex profile; Class II skeletal pattern; angle Class I malocclusion; crowding of lower incisors; biprotrusion; and endodontic and restorative treatment of the traumatized left maxillary central incisor. Four first premolars were extracted to reduce dental protrusion and correct crowding of the lower incisors.

pmc-12736137.title: Electrochemical Synthesis of Methoxy-NNO-azoxy Compounds via N=N Bond Formation Between Ammonium N-(methoxy)nitramide and Nitroso Compounds
pmc-12736137.creator: Alexander S Budnikov, Andrey A Kulikov, Michael S Klenov, Nikita E Leonov, Igor B Krylov, Alexander O Terent’ev, Vladimir A Tartakovsky, Roman Dembinski, Jacek Nycz
pmc-12736137.description: In this study, atom- and step-efficient electrochemical coupling of nitroso compounds with ammonium N-(methoxy)nitramide, furnishing methoxy-NNO-azoxy compounds, is reported. The developed protocol employs a divided electrochemical cell, proceeds under constant-current electrolysis conditions, and is applicable to aromatic, heterocyclic, and aliphatic nitroso compounds.

pmc-13242172.title: Ivermectin Bezoar: An Unusual Case Presentation
pmc-13242172.creator: Samuel M Miller, Lucy Ruangvoravat, Felix Y Lui, Bishwajit Bhattacharya
pmc-13242172.description: This case report presents an older male who presented with small bowel obstruction after ingesting ivermectin horse paste that he had purchased online without a prescription. Unfortunately, ingestion of ivermectin by humans, including non-human formulations, has become more common after it was misrepresented as a treatment for COVID during the pandemic.

pmc-13373782.title: Hypercholesterolemia enhances early dissemination and Borrelia burgdorferi burden in a mouse model
pmc-13373782.creator: Julia González, Lauren Hinger, Nikhat Parveen, Alvaro Toledo
pmc-13373782.description: The Lyme disease spirochete, Borrelia burgdorferi, requires cholesterol to grow. The spirochete acquires cholesterol from the host to form cholesterol glycolipids, which are then incorporated into the spirochete’s membrane. This study aimed to determine whether higher levels of serum cholesterol could facilitate the infection and contribute to the pathogenesis of Lyme disease.

pmc-13376107.title: A comprehensive review of iatrogenic rectovaginal fistula after rectal cancer surgery
pmc-13376107.creator: Andrea Martina Guida, Luigi Eduardo Conte, Antonella Paone, Amedeo Antonelli, Alessio Lucarini, Andrea Divizia
pmc-13376107.description: Iatrogenic rectovaginal fistula (RVF) following total mesorectal excision for rectal cancer is an uncommon but profoundly disabling complication, imposing major physical, functional, sexual, and psychosocial burdens. Its pathogenesis is multifactorial, often arising in an inflamed, irradiated, or fibrotic pelvis, and compounded by coexisting anastomotic defects.

pmc-13591111.title: BcMFSR Is Required for Efficient Uptake of Exogenous dsRNA and Spray‐Induced Gene Silencing in Botrytis cinerea
pmc-13591111.creator: Le Xu, Ze Yu, Ruonan Du, Huijie Ma, Xiaoxiao Hu, Ran Wei, Qiwang Hu, Cong Sheng, Wambui Doris Njoki, Pan Chen, Xuechao Shi, Cheng Tang, Huameng Zhang, Shaoxia Zhou, Haoming Zhong, Weishu Wang, Isashova Umida, Hongwei Zhao
pmc-13591111.description: Spray‐induced gene silencing (SIGS) uses exogenous double‐stranded RNA (dsRNA) to suppress pathogen virulence or growth‐related genes, offering a promising strategy for controlling grey mould caused by Botrytis cinerea at the gene level. In this study, we investigated the molecular mechanisms underlying the efficient uptake of dsRNAs by B.
